boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hope College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Holland food stops with late availability documented by current university or business pages.

cards.title: Order Ahead at Kletz Market
cards.subtitle: A campus option with mobile ordering until 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Place the order before the mobile cutoff, then follow the app’s pickup instructions; the walk-up market itself closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: The campus-based choice for an evening mobile order.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope College states that Kletz Market remains open until 8 p.m. and mobile ordering is available until 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Walk-up service closes at 8 p.m.; Hope College says mobile ordering is available until 10 p.m. Confirm pickup details in GET before ordering.

cards.title: Cabill Drive McDonald’s Until 11
cards.subtitle: An east-side restaurant and drive-thru open nightly to 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the lobby or drive-thru before 11 p.m.; check the official location page again if traveling during a holiday or campus break.
cards.short_summary: A predictable 11 p.m. option east of central Holland.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists both restaurant/lobby and drive-thru hours through 11 p.m. every day at 762 Cabill Drive.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Holland, MI at 762 Cabill Dr | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Restaurant, lobby, and drive-thru are listed as open until 11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Friday or Saturday at Chick-fil-A
cards.subtitle: A North Park Drive run with weekend drive-thru service until 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday and use the drive-thru by 11 p.m.; dine-in and carry-out finish at 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-only late window on Holland’s north side.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists Friday and Saturday restaurant hours and drive-thru service until 11 p.m. at 2332 North Park Drive.
cards.access_notes: Friday–Saturday restaurant and drive-thru hours end at 11 p.m.; dine-in and carry-out end at 10 p.m. Closed Sunday.

cards.title: The All-Night Subway Run
cards.subtitle: A Mobil-location restaurant officially listed as open 24 hours daily.
cards.notes: Head north to the Riley Street Mobil when other kitchens are closed; verify ordering availability on the location page before leaving.
cards.short_summary: The board’s only officially documented round-the-clock restaurant.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway lists its Mobil Gas/C-Store restaurant at 12757 Riley Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Subway at 12757 Riley St Holland MI
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists store hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Midnight on East 16th Street
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-thru service documented until midnight every night.
cards.notes: Take 16th Street east and arrive before midnight; both the restaurant and drive-thru share the same published closing time.
cards.short_summary: A nightly midnight cutoff southeast of Hope’s campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours from 10 a.m. to midnight daily at 816 East 16th Street.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed as open until midnight seven days a week.

cards.title: North River Avenue at Midnight
cards.subtitle: A downtown-edge Wendy’s with daily service through midnight.
cards.notes: Continue north from downtown and order by midnight; the official page gives identical closing times for restaurant and drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A midnight run just beyond Holland’s downtown blocks.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours through midnight every day at 250 North River Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed as open until midnight Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Westshore Drive Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A north-side restaurant and drive-thru open later than the other local Wendy’s entries.
cards.notes: Use this longer north-side run when a 1 a.m. close is useful; the restaurant and drive-thru carry the same daily schedule.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day 1 a.m. window near the Westshore retail area.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists both restaurant and drive-thru service until 1 a.m. every day at 3176 Westshore Drive.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed as open until 1 a.m. Monday through Sunday.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 25 South Waverly Road
cards.title: Waverly Road Until 3 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A drive-thru option with an officially documented 3 a.m. close.
cards.notes: Plan on drive-thru access for the latest window and check the live page before departure; published dine-in hours may differ.
cards.short_summary: A late east-side drive-thru with hours extending past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours from 7 a.m. to 3 a.m. daily at 25 South Waverly Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Holland, MI - 25 S Waverly Rd
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are listed through 3 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are separate and may close earlier.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 1144 South Washington Avenue
cards.title: South Washington Until 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A southbound drive-thru run documented through 2 a.m. nightly.
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru after the dining room closes and arrive before 2 a.m.; confirm the official schedule around holidays.
cards.short_summary: A late south-side option with an earlier dine-in cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours from 7 a.m. to 2 a.m. daily at 1144 South Washington.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Holland, MI - 1144 South Washington
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are listed through 2 a.m. every day; the published dine-in closing time is 11 p.m.

cards.title: Washington Avenue at Midnight
cards.subtitle: A south-side Wendy’s currently listed through midnight.
cards.notes: Pair this straightforward southbound run with the official midnight cutoff; recheck the location page before setting out late.
cards.short_summary: A second Washington Avenue choice with a midnight endpoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Holland location listing shows the restaurant at 1162 Washington Avenue open until midnight.
cards.access_notes: The official Wendy's Holland listing shows this location open until midnight; confirm the service channel on arrival.

warnings: Late-night hours can change for holidays, college breaks, weather, or temporary operations; recheck each direct source before departure.
